<div class="card-body">
'''Cold Feet''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">凍り付いた足</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">マーカー位置にいるキャラクターを目標とする。運命数を引く。その位置が“夜間状態”なら運命数に２を加える。運命数の合計＞能力値なら、目標のキャラクターはこのターンの終わりまで移動することができない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Cold-Feet-SWCA-100668.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ワンパは捕まえた獲物の手足を雪で固めて動けなくしておく。ホスの冷気を利用して獲物の動きを封じるのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Cold Feet.

'''Card text:'''
Target a character at a marker location. Draw destiny. If that location is under nighttime conditions, add 2 to destiny. If total destiny exceeds ability, the target character cannot move until the end of this turn.

'''Lore:'''
Wampas pack snow around the limbs of captured prey so they cannot move. They use the cold on Hoth to keep their prey still.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese printing uses 位置 (location) where the English original uses site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Cold Feet]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
